sections.title: Related account from the author
sections.text: Knight’s later discussion describes starting with a vocabulary and spatial relations, developing restricted basic grammars and extending them toward architectural designs. This summarizes that later account, not a verified reading of the chapter.

sections.text: The original chapter’s complete exercises, illustrations, argument and conclusions have not been checked. Its CUMINCAD access route is retained without bypassing the site’s verification.
